title: LLM isolation X6b: the allowed_clis pins of 7 profiles move into routing data, so an agy-only table can compile
summary: After X6 (#1123) the Claude floor is routing data, but 7 tracked profiles still pin allowed_clis to Claude families: auditor, adversarial-review, tdd-engineer, spec-verifier, spec-verify and code-reviewer set ["claude"], and router sets ["agy-claude", "claude"] (.evolve/profiles/*.json). A policy that routes every seat to agy with floors {} still cannot compile, so matrix rows M2 to M5 stay red. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §10; plan §6.2.
fix: Move each profile pin into cli_routing (the floors data or the agent chain) with the same values, and drop allowed_clis from the 7 profiles. evolve cli-routing explain prints the same chain for each agent before and after; record both outputs in the PR.
acceptance: RED first: matrix row M2 (agy is the only route, floors {}) fails on the profile allowed_clis pins after X6
evolve cli-routing explain is byte-identical for every profile before and after
Matrix rows M2 and M3 pass with floors {} in the test policy
Changed functions at 100% coverage; spec §10 and the profiles and cliroute package notes updated
